headlines.title: Wall Street meltdown: Tech stocks drop sharply as AI hype cools
headlines.description: A bruising stock market sell-off continued despite a record-setting IPO by Anthropic, dashing hopes it would revive sentiment on the AI trade.

headlines.title: White House national cyber director is leaving the administration after series of tech outages
headlines.description: Sean Cairncross has played a key role in crafting AI policy for the Trump administration. His immediate replacement is Kirsten A. Davies.

headlines.title: What is Behind the Recent String of Tech Outages?
headlines.description: After a week that saw multiple tech issues, from a Microsoft outage to the FAA’s nationwide ground stop, many Americans were asking if these disruptions could really all be just a coincidence. Experts say artificial intelligence helps companies discover software vulnerabilities faster than ever before, though fixing them can sometimes lead to more issues or trigger an outage. NBC’s Allie Canal shares more in this week’s Sunday Focus.

headlines.title: FBI Investigating Potential Breach of Its Crime Database
headlines.description: The FBI is investigating whether hackers were able to breach its crime database at a time when the country is on high alert about the vulnerability of its technical systems both inside the government and out. NBC’s Julie Tsirkin reports for Sunday TODAY.

headlines.title: Markets plummet as tech sell-off intensifies
headlines.description: The stock market plummeted as a tech sell-off intensified after Anthropic's record-setting IPO. Nvidia also dragged markets lower, tumbling about 14% following a Reuters report that regulators are looking into accounting irregularities at the chip giant.

headlines.title: Trump says recent tech outages 'all separate events' and 'bad things happen' with upgrades
headlines.description: President Trump said the various widespread technical outages over the past week across multiple companies are "all separate." He emphasized that last week's federal ground stop was "different" because the technology is "ancient" and needs to be replaced.

headlines.title: Anthropic stock is down during its second day of trading after a historic Wall Street debut
headlines.description: After Anthropic's historic Wall Street debut, its stock is down during its second day of trading. NBC News' Brian Cheung and editor-in-chief at Investopedia, Caleb Silver, break down the latest details of the decline and what's at stake.

headlines.title: Anthropic breaks record with IPO
headlines.description: After the first day of trading, AI company Anthropic is worth more than $1.7 trillion. NBC News’ Christine Romans reports how today’s IPO means the company’s seven co-founders are now each worth more than $23 billion.

headlines.title: National cyber director to leave Trump administration
headlines.description: A White House official says Sean Cairncross will leave his position as National Cyber Director. The news comes as the country has been dealing with a series of tech outages. NBC News’ Stephanie Gosk reports.

headlines.title: American entrepreneurs move to China’s tech hub
headlines.description: NBC Nightly News anchor Tom Llamas reports from Shenzhen, where some American entrepreneurs are betting on China’s tech boom despite its weakening economy.

headlines.title: California's attorney general subpoenas Nvidia on whether its chips ended up in China
headlines.description: California Attorney General Rob Bonta served an investigative subpoena to Nvidia to find out whether its chips ended up in China. NBC News' Jared Perlo reports on how the subpoena serves to discover whether Nvidia misled investors.

headlines.title: 'It's an extraordinary morning': College student reacts to Anthropic and GTA's big day
headlines.description: A college student speaks with Christine Romans on his experience buying Anthropic shares and playing the new Grand Theft Auto on the same day both were released.
